format: WSDC Registry Events, role separation for correction co-signing

source.quote_free_summary: Event Director(s)/Owner(s) must not perform Chief Judge, Judge or scoring duties; Chief Judge and scoring/tabulation are separate individuals; judges decide independently and altering scores is not allowed.

requirement: Corrections need designated Event Director/Owner, Chief Judge and scoring operator roles (OD-06); the corrected result is calculated by the scoring operator and verified by a different Chief Judge/Event Director; no ballot alteration.
interpretation_notes: Designations do not exist yet (OD-06 designed, not built); WSDC-declared events fail closed. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
